_comment: Manual data file. Copy to data/network.json to use it.
Every top-level key is optional — supply only what no connector can reach yet.
Money is in whole CENTS. States are USPS two-letter codes.
Set "demo": false once these are real numbers; the demo banner keys off it.
_revenueDaily_comment: Optional. Powers the 1W and 1M ranges on the revenue chart.
Only include it if you genuinely have day-level figures — the dashboard
will not split monthly totals into days, and says so instead.
Stripe supplies this automatically; you rarely need it here.
